non_obvious_findings.finding: The served Universal Shell already advertises page_change_threads, page_change_feed and disposable_agent_launcher. The swarm-era Page Change Thread bridge should therefore adapt these served mechanisms to durable planner/worker/steward evidence instead of replacing the user-facing mechanism.

The page-change client already exposes prepare_execution, prepare_research and execution_status keyed by page identity. This is a concrete seam for one-message human correction -> worker work -> same-surface result, not merely an architectural aspiration.

Context Foundry v2 is reusable infrastructure but remains TESTED_CANDIDATE in Current Graph. A Control surface may consume its contracts for context compilation without representing it as independently Human Accepted or Served.

protected_invariants: Live/Control Room are derived projections, never the brain or authority ledger.
Capture private payloads remain outside public coordination.
PageKit/product-local identity remains separate from global shell identity.
Candidate, Current, Human Accepted and Served remain distinct.
Unknown routes remain unresolved instead of guessed.
The /wc universal swarm remains canary until explicit production readiness/promotion gates pass.

dedup_check.reason_no_new_opportunity: The concrete follow-up seams discovered here are already represented by prepared Page Thread bridge, surface registry, Control Room, local steward and control-plan integration lanes. Adding another lane would duplicate prepared work.

integration_handoff.instruction: Treat this reuse map as a consume-not-rebuild ledger. Bind the local campaign to existing Universal Shell/Capture/Agent Runtime/Context Foundry authority and preserve unresolved route/authority boundaries.
